messages.content:
You are the document assistant for Halvicor Systems. You answer questions using only the company documents you can reach with your tools. The user's access level decides which documents you can see.

How to work:
1. Call search_docs first. Use open_doc to read a whole document when a snippet is not enough or when you need to check its status.
2. Prefer documents with status "current". Never rely on a document with status "superseded" when a current version exists.
3. Finish by calling final_answer. You have at most 5 tool calls in total, including final_answer.

Rules for final_answer:
- Use only facts stated in the documents. Do not use outside knowledge.
- Give at least one citation. Each quote must be copied exactly, word for word, from the cited document.
- If the documents do not answer the question, or a document you need is not available to you, call final_answer with refusal set to true and a short reason. Do not guess.
When is the production deploy freeze?

## Deploy windows

Production deploys run Monday to Friday between 09:00 and 16:00. There is a deploy freeze from Friday 14:00 until Monday 09:00.","score":9.915},{"docId":"rb-deploy","title":"Deployment Runbook","snippet":"## Approvals

Every production deploy needs approval from two engineers. Emergency fixes for a SEV1 may be deployed during the freeze with approval from the incident commander.","score":9.5},{"docId":"rb-access-request","title":"Production Access Runbook","snippet":"# Production Access Runbook

## Requesting access

Request production access in the Access Portal. Your manager and the service owner must both approve it.","score":4.362},{"docId":"rb-access-request","title":"Production Access Runbook","snippet":"## Expiry

Production access expires after 30 days. Request it again if you still need it.","score":4.119},{"docId":"rb-access-request","title":"Production Access Runbook","snippet":"## Break-glass access

Break-glass access is for emergencies only. Every use is logged and reviewed by the security team within 24 hours.","score":2.67}]

{"docId":"rb-deploy","title":"Deployment Runbook","version":1,"status":"current","body":"# Deployment Runbook

## Deploy windows

Production deploys run Monday to Friday between 09:00 and 16:00. There is a deploy freeze from Friday 14:00 until Monday 09:00.

## Approvals

Every production deploy needs approval from two engineers. Emergency fixes for a SEV1 may be deployed during the freeze with approval from the incident commander.

## Rollback

To roll back, run `relayctl rollback --to previous` and post in the #deploys channel."}

function.name: search_docs
function.description: Keyword search over the company documents you are allowed to see. Returns up to 5 matching paragraphs.

function.name: open_doc
function.description: Read a whole document, including its version and status (current or superseded).

docId.description: The docId from a search result.

function.name: final_answer
function.description: Finish with an answer and its citations, or with a refusal.

answer.description: The answer, using only facts from the documents.

citations.description: At least one source. Each quote must be copied exactly, word for word, from the document.

refusal.description: Set to true when the documents do not answer the question.

arguments.answer: There is a deploy freeze from Friday 14:00 until Monday 09:00.

citations.quote: There is a deploy freeze from Friday 14:00 until Monday 09:00.

arguments.reason: The search results and the opened document explicitly state the deploy freeze time.
